source.scope: store-wide (NOT product-scoped) — an order belongs to Direct if its first-session channel is classified Direct (no referrer, no UTM params, typed the URL or used a bookmark). Split out of the Organic tab into its own tab/page (per user request, 2026-07-30) — checked before Organic so Direct orders never land there anymore.. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Direct -> Organic -> CPPC -> Thishoban -> Theekshy -> Thanishtika) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab. Standalone page, built 2026-07-27.
